analysis_steps.goal: Fit smooth, gap and ring models to the intensity profile

referee_caveats_inferred: Single object and a single 3 mm image; gap vs ring cannot be distinguished (delta AIC ~1.4)
Gap/ring significance rests on the radial-profile model choice and a log-likelihood with bin errors sigma/sqrt(N); beam-correlated pixels may make the errors underestimated
Temperature outside 15 au is an extrapolation of a -0.5 power law, so tau and mass depend on that assumption
Disk mass uses tau = 8 constant and kappa = 1 cm2/g; large opacity uncertainty
Sensitivity to the self-calibration of a combined C-10 + C-6 dataset at a primary-beam response of 0.35 is not tested for imaging artifacts
